mechanism_narrative: A sustained acceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average, coupled with a concurrent rise in industrial production (INDPRO), signals an expansionary demand shock that boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average, combined with a concurrent contraction in housing starts (HOUST), signals a supply-side recessionary shock that depresses corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above its 12-month moving average, combined with a concurrent rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL), signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above its 12-month moving average, combined with a concurrent decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS), signals a labor market deterioration that depresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
